defmodule SearchService.Router do use Plug.Router require Logger plug :match plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:urlencoded, :json], pass: ["text/*"], json_decoder: Jason plug :dispatch # Health check for Kubernetes liveness probe get "/healthz" do send_resp(conn, 200, "ok") end # Readiness probe get "/readyz" do send_resp(conn, 200, "ready") end # Search endpoint that renders results page get "/search" do conn = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn) query = Map.get(conn.query_params, "q", "") callback = Map.get(conn.query_params, "callback", nil) page = Map.get(conn.query_params, "page", "1") results = SearchService.Engine.search(query, String.to_integer(page)) case callback do nil -> html = SearchService.View.render_results(query, results, page) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, html) cb -> json_results = Jason.encode!(%{query: query, results: results}) conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/javascript") |> send_resp(200, "#{cb}(#{json_results})") end end # API endpoint for internal service mesh communication post "/api/v1/index" do case conn.body_params do %{"documents" => docs} when is_list(docs) -> SearchService.Engine.index_documents(docs) send_resp(conn, 201, Jason.encode!(%{indexed: length(docs)})) _ -> send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid payload"})) end end match _ do send_resp(conn, 404, "not found") end end defmodule SearchService.View do @moduledoc """ Renders HTML views for the search service. Uses a Content Security Policy and sanitizes output. """ def render_results(query, results, page) do sanitized_query = html_escape(query) results_html = Enum.map_join(results, "\n", &render_result/1) """ Search: #{sanitized_query}

Search Results

#{results_html}
#{render_pagination(page, length(results))}
""" end defp render_result(%{title: title, snippet: snippet, url: url}) do """

#{html_escape(title)}

#{html_escape(snippet)}

""" end defp render_result(_), do: "" defp render_pagination(page, result_count) when result_count >= 10 do page_int = String.to_integer(page) """
#{if page_int > 1, do: "« Prev", else: ""} Page #{page_int} Next »
""" end defp render_pagination(_, _), do: "" @doc """ Escapes HTML special characters to prevent XSS. Handles &, <, >, \", and ' characters. """ def html_escape(nil), do: "" def html_escape(text) when is_binary(text) do text |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end end defmodule SearchService.Engine do @moduledoc "Simple in-memory search engine for demonstration" use Agent def start_link(_opts) do Agent.start_link(fn -> [] end, name: __MODULE__) end def search(query, _page) when query == "", do: [] def search(query, _page) do Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn docs -> docs |> Enum.filter(fn doc -> String.contains?(String.downcase(doc.title <> doc.snippet), String.downcase(query)) end) |> Enum.take(10) end) end def index_documents(docs) do parsed = Enum.map(docs, fn doc -> %{title: doc["title"] || "", snippet: doc["snippet"] || "", url: doc["url"] || ""} end) Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn existing -> existing ++ parsed end) end end defmodule SearchService.Application do use Application def start(_type, _args) do port = String.to_integer(System.get_env("PORT") || "4000") children = [ SearchService.Engine, {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: SearchService.Router, options: [port: port]} ] opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: SearchService.Supervisor] Supervisor.start_link(children, opts) end end
